## Michael Intrator

This is already showing up across our platform. For example, approximately 80% of CoreWeave Cloud customers paying at least \$1 million per year have adopted one or more of our storage products. Additionally, we are seeing strong cross-selling momentum with Weights & Biases, as we added hundreds of millions of CoreWeave Cloud TCV from Weights & Biases customers in the second half of the year. We have also accelerated the development of CoreWeave's proprietary cloud stack, reference architecture and related software solutions, including SUNK and Mission Control, which orchestrate every layer of our purpose-built cloud and increasingly define the CoreWeave customer experience.

In January, we announced NVIDIA intends to test and validate our platform, including our software and reference architectures, to work towards including those offerings within NVIDIA's reference architecture for cloud, enterprise and sovereign customers. Already, we are seeing select customers license SUNK as their default research cluster management platform across their multi-cloud footprint.
